nodes.label: receipt_preview.html - printReceipt() visual preview
nodes.rationale: A 1:1 static preview of printer_service.dart's printReceipt() thermal-roll output (58mm width, monospace font) using dummy sale data, including the address/register-designation block, sale date/time, VAT breakdown, payment line, legal/control-code block, and manufacturing number - mirrors the fields added in the 2026-08-20 receipt redesign changelog entry.
